# Harvard Mexas dinner — last Saturday

Fourteen people, six new. Harvard Square, 19:00 to 22:30.

## Who mattered
- **Sofía Treviño** — the family-office intro. I owe her the one-pager.
- **Andrés Villarreal** — knows NEST; vouched for Matthew Hale.
- **Tomás Aguirre** — industrial policy; wants the Ferra story.
- **Camila Ortega** — runs the list; asked me to speak in the spring.

## What worked
Saying Monterrey early. Asking about their work before mine.

## What did not
I stayed with the Mexicans for the first hour. Next time, two strangers first.
